title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About VEL

Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building chat interfaces.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.


The Role

The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s strategic execution partner — responsible for converting executive intent into structured, measurable execution across the company.


You will operate across:

● Product (Physical AI systems)

● Fundraise and capital coordination

● Manufacturing partners

● Real estate and deployment strategy

● International expansion

● Board and investor communications


This is not an administrative role.

This is not calendar management.

This is a cross-functional force multiplier role embedded in high-velocity decision environments.


You will:

● Translate CEO strategy into executable workstreams

● Drive OKR cadence and operational rhythm

● Prepare board materials and investor updates

● Support capital raise execution and investor coordination

● Maintain discipline across execution systems (Monday.com, Miro, etc.)

● Identify risk early and enforce accountability

● Coordinate cross-border stakeholders

This role requires executive maturity, commercial literacy, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● Minimum 3 years serving as Chief of Staff reporting directly to a CEO

● Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth environment

● Direct exposure to capital raise cycles

● Ownership of board-level documentation and reporting

● Financial literacy (runway, unit economics, forecasting inputs)

● Experience implementing structured execution systems

● Strong English communication

● Willingness to travel extensively

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup in growth stage

● An infrastructure, hardware, or deep-tech environment

● A company operating across multiple countries

● A high-velocity environment with capital exposure


You understand that:

● Execution discipline determines survival

● Capital alignment drives strategy

● Ambiguity is normal at scale-building companies

● Board-level communication must be precise

● Travel is part of building global infrastructure

You prefer ownership over supervision.

You are comfortable operating without detailed instructions.


Who Should Not Apply

● Executive Assistants repositioning as Chief of Staff

● Strategy consultants without operating accountability

● Candidates without capital exposure

● Individuals unwilling to travel 90–120 days per year

● Candidates seeking low-intensity environments

What We Offer

● Direct CEO exposure

● Global operational footprint

● Board-level experience

● Infrastructure-scale problem set

● Equity upside

● Responsibility for execution coherence across the company

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.


Travel Requirement: 90–120 days per year (US, Europe, GCC)

This role requires regular international travel for investor engagement, manufacturing coordination, and deployment oversight. Candidates must be fully comfortable operating in a travel-intensive environment.


Compensation: $60,000–$85,000 USD + meaningful equity

Compensation will be aligned to experience, depth of operating exposure, and prior executive-level responsibility. Equity participation reflects the strategic importance of this role.


Reporting Line: Reports directly to the CEO

This is a senior strategic position with cross-functional authority across product, capital, manufacturing, and deployment.


Role Type: Full-time, long-term strategic hire

This is not a contract position. We are building foundational infrastructure and expect long-term ownership and accountability.

title: Líder Técnico / PO Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional sênior para atuar como Líder Técnico/PO , com atuação complementar como PO técnico, em um contexto de modernização e evolução de arquitetura de dados.


Se você tem visão arquitetural, maturidade técnica e gosta de ser referência estratégica em projetos estruturantes, essa oportunidade pode ser sua próxima evolução profissional.


Missão da posição:

Atuar como referência técnica na definição, evolução e sustentação da arquitetura de dados e integrações corporativas, garantindo qualidade, governança e escalabilidade das soluções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Definir e evoluir arquitetura de dados e integrações corporativas

- Orientar decisões técnicas e arquiteturais

- Estabelecer padrões, boas práticas e diretrizes de desenvolvimento

- Revisar pipelines, integrações e soluções técnicas

- Apoiar tecnicamente equipes multidisciplinares

- Contribuir com refinamento técnico e priorização de demandas

- Garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e governança das entregas

- Atuar como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia


Requisitos Técnicos:

- Experiência sólida como Líder Técnico em projetos de dados ou analytics

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de dados e integrações

- Vivência em projetos de Data Lake e modernização de plataformas

- Experiência com integração de sistemas ERP

- Domínio de ETL/ELT e pipelines de dados

- Conhecimento avançado em modelagem de dados analíticos

- Domínio de SQL

- Experiência em ambientes Cloud

- Experiência com ferramentas de visualização e definição de camadas de dados

- Conhecimento em governança, qualidade e segurança da informação


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em projetos de migração ou transformação arquitetural

- Certificações em Cloud ou Arquitetura de Dados

- Pós-graduação na área


Modelo de contratação:

- Contratação PJ

- Atuação remota


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: TypeScript Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Typescript Developer to join our company, and collaborate with team members to build flexible, scalable, and maintainable mobile apps. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language, and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user.


Key responsibilities:


- Plan, develop and implement user interface strategy.

- Work on the design, look, and feel of our web properties.

- Work with designers and developers to develop modern, intuitive user interfaces for our web properties.

- Improve JS and CSS quality by conducting code analysis, and recommending changes in policies and procedures.

- Continuously improve the user experience.

- Research user preferences.

- Research new technologies and best practices.

- Work in a team environment with shared code; disciplined use of source code control and process documentation.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience with TypeScript.

- Software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications in JavaScript (React, Vue), HTML, CSS, SCSS, and JQuery.

- Experience with AJAX, XML, JSON, and best practice design patterns.

- A solid understanding of design principles/patterns and test-driven development using Unit Testing (Jest or equivalent).

- Experience with caching systems and knowledge of User Experience design methodologies will be an added advantage.

- Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Great interpersonal and communication skills.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Oracle Cloud HCM Engineer- Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 4-7 years of experience in application integration.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or equivalent iPaaS .
  • At least 3 years of experience in SQL/ETL.
  • Proven experience with Oracle Cloud HCM , particularly Core HR processes and data model (assignments, salaries, organization structures).
  • Expertise in OIC, including orchestrations, REST/SOAP adapters, and XSLT.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL.
  • Working knowledge of HDL/HSDL and BI Publisher (data model, bursting, security).
  • Ability to design, implement, and operate integrations around Oracle Cloud HCM, leveraging Oracle standards and tools (HCM Extracts, REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience in gathering requirements, securing data flows (GDPR compliance), documenting deliverables, and participating in architecture and data reviews.
  • Fluent in English (Expert level) and French are a plus.
  • Available to realocate to Portugal and work in hybrid setting in Lisbon.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

title: Engenheiro de dados Sênior
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;

Atendentes Comercial Bilíngue (Inglês Nativo Americano)

title: ESPECIALISTA EM ESTATÍSTICA E DADOS
description:
Company Description

A XMX Corp é uma empresa de performance digital focada em escalar funis de vendas com base em dados e resultados reais. Atuamos com marketing direto, otimização de conversão e inteligência operacional para maximizar lucro e eficiência. Nosso principal foco é atrair e desenvolver afiliados de alta performance, fortalecendo nosso modelo B2B e ampliando escala. Valorizamos velocidade, adaptação e execução prática para crescer de forma consistente e sustentável.


RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Estruturar modelos estatísticos para apoiar decisões estratégicas da empresa;
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos avançados para análise de performance (funil, ofertas, backend, retenção, reembolso, churn);
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para:
  • Projeção de receita
  • Probabilidade de recompra
  • Tendência de reembolso
  • Lifetime Value (LTV)
  • Elasticidade de preço
  • Analisar experimentos e testes A/B com rigor estatístico
  • Criar modelos de atribuição e correlação entre variáveis de negócio;
  • Elevar o nível de confiabilidade dos dados e análises da empresa;
  • Identificar vieses, inconsistências e distorções nos dados;
  • Construir dashboards estratégicos com foco em tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar diretoria na interpretação estatística de cenários e projeções;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Funil, Backend, Financeiro e Oferta para traduzir dados em estratégias práticas.
  • Organização de todos os testes que estão sendo feitos na empresa, documentação e análise.
QUALIFICAÇÕES:
  • Formação sólida em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de estatística descritiva e inferencial;
  • Conhecimento profundo em:
  • Probabilidade
  • Regressão
  • Testes de hipótese
  • Modelagem preditiva
  • Séries temporais
  • Análise multivariada
  • Experiência com análise de experimentos (A/B testing);
  • Experiência com grandes bases de dados;
  • Capacidade de traduzir análises complexas em decisões claras para o negócio.
  • Diferencial :
  • Conhecimento em Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels ou similares); 
  • Conhecimento em SQL;
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta velocidade (startup ou digital).
  • Experiência com marketing digital ou e-commerce;
COMPETÊNCIAS:
  • RIGOR ANALÍTICO
  • PENSAMENTO LÓGICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • PRECISÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE SIMPLIFICAR O COMPLEXO
  • PROATIVIDADE
SALÁRIO:
  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo trimestre dentro da empresa.
TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office
COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:
  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Senior Media Buyer | Stealth Manager
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Lead Generation & Patient Acquisition) | 100% remote


About the Role

We are hiring a senior-level performance marketer to own strategy, execution, and optimization of multi-account paid media campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking for local healthcare providers. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

title: Analista de Administração Pessoal e Benefícios Junior
description:
Responsável por assegurar a correta administração dos processos de ponto, benefícios e apoio aos cálculos de folha de pagamento, garantindo conformidade legal, acuracidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará no controle e conferência de dados trabalhistas, apoiando a consistência dos lançamentos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de administração de pessoal.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão e conferência do controle de ponto eletrônico, tratando inconsistências, banco de horas, horas extras, afastamentos e escalas.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos legais e obrigações acessórias relacionadas à compra, cadastro e disponibilização dos benefícios.
  • Atuar na interface com fornecedores de folha e benefícios, assegurando qualidade e precisão das informações.
  • Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento, realizando conferências prévias, validação de eventos e suporte aos cálculos trabalhistas.
  • Administrar benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde, seguro, entre outros), incluindo movimentações, inclusões, exclusões e conferências de faturas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e controles internos relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar o controle e cálculo de férias, 13º salário, admissões, desligamentos e encargos sociais.


Formação e Conhecimentos

  • Nível superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em administração de pessoal e rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Vivência com controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e encargos sociais.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de folha e e-Social.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING


Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


(Musts)

We’re looking for someone that has hands-on experience with:

  • WordPress & Elementor.
  • SEO
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • Creating content for email marketing campaigns
  • Landing page creation


This role is not for you if:

  • You have only worked with Ads and paid media before.
  • You have only worked for marketing agencies before
  • You don't have any experience with generating leads and measuring the results .


Nice to have:

  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: Azure Cloud Architect - 100% Remote
description:
Azure Cloud Architect - 100% Remote

Candidate Location – Brazil

12 Months plus contract

Start date - immediately

Rate - DOE


15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM


Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Working experience with various industry domains like banking, healthcare, Insurance
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Provide the Azure target architecture and its BoM pricing and licensing related details
  • Azure Target Solutions architect Diagram (all Azure services) including HLD & LLD
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

title: Accounting Manager - US GAAP
description:
Lead US Accounting. Operate at a Global Standard.

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.


The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership


What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency


What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Executive Assistant (Technical)
description:
Executive Assistant (Technical)

Salary: $1250 - $1500 / month

Working Hours: Central Time

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location : Remote


About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the founder across both traditional EA responsibilities and technical project coordination.


You’ll help keep day-to-day operations organized, while also translating ideas and conversations into clear work streams that developers can execute against.


We’re looking for someone product-minded — someone who thinks about how things should work, asks good questions, and cares about quality. If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with software tools and technical teams, this role is a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the founder with traditional executive assistant tasks (scheduling, organization, follow-ups, documentation, coordination)
  • Watch client calls or internal discussions and turn them into clear work streams and task lists
  • Explain to developers exactly what needs to be built and why
  • Test features and applications after development and document issues or improvements
  • Perform light setup and cleanup in tools like Airtable, Notion, and Excel / Google Sheets


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • +2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Comfortable using tools like Excel / Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, and task management tools
  • Able to communicate clearly with both non-technical and technical teammates


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting US-based founders or agencies
  • Prior exposure to QA / testing or software-related projects


Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founder
  • Get hands-on experience coordinating real software and automation projects
  • Build transferable skills in technical project coordination and operations

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Staff Frontend Software Engineer | BASE Team
description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Brazil
Expires at:
Remote policy: Full remote GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Frontend Software Engineer (Individual Contributor) to join our BASE FA Teams in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services), we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.
In this role, you will go beyond coding — you will drive technical excellence across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping frontend architecture, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions. As a Staff/Specialist Frontend Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of some critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the beginning of the product lifecycle, partnering with product and design, defining technical approaches, and delivering high-impact solutions. Your work will ensure performance, reliability, and overall product excellence across BASE services.
This role combines strong frontend expertise with leadership in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from system architecture to implementation.
YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the frontend development in the BASE Focus Area, influencing architecture and design decisions across teams.
  • Design and implement straightforward solutions to complex scenarios, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to translate vision and needs into technical solutions that make sense to the engineering team, and vice versa.
  • Serve as a focal point in the communication with other teams and areas of the company.
  • Serve as a technical reference to the team and gain recognition as such across the company.
  • Mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.
Main requirements WHO YOU ARE

  • A specialist frontend software engineer with strong expertise in React and React Native , along with a solid understanding of related technologies.
  • Experienced in distributed systems and modern system designs, including cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, Backend for Frontend (BFFs), Micro Frontends, as well as web and mobile applications.
  • Skilled in designing and developing complex modern mobile and web applications.
  • Experienced with RESTful and GraphQL services, collaborating with backend teams to create mockups, define payloads, and follow HTTP best practices.
  • Capable of architecting large-scale, multi-tier web applications.
  • A team player who thrives in collaborative environments, providing mentorship to junior colleagues and actively seeking support from peers.
  • An effective communicator, both written and verbal, able to clearly articulate ideas across cultures and geographies in both Portuguese and English.
  • A professional with strong desire for learning and self-development, holding a bachelor’s degree in computer science or possessing equivalent professional experience.

title: Senior Engineering Manager | CXTech
description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Multiple Locations
Expires at:
Remote policy: Full remote We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to our CXTech team in Brazil or Portugal ! 
As a Senior Engineering Manager you will lead three teams that develop solutions to be used by the Customer Experience team, guiding tech leads and fostering an environment of technical excellence and strong team dynamics. Your role is pivotal in shaping the engineering and product development landscapes, ensuring that our technical strategies align seamlessly with business objectives.
CXTech uses artificial intelligence to build scalable self-service support solutions to decrease ticket volume and streamline complex issue resolution for greater efficiency and productivity.
The CXTech team is responsible for developing and maintaining the entire CX ecosystem such as Help Center, online and offline support, internal customer management system and customer support system( Zendesk). The main KPIs are digital deflection, overall contact rate, human agent productivity, and chatbot CSAT.
YOUR IMPACT
  • Guide the team with AI solutions to increase deflection and improve customer support efficiency;
  • Oversee, mentor, and guide one or multiple engineering teams and their leads to deliver on large-scale projects with high complexity, ensuring alignment with company goals and strategic priorities;
  • Partner with senior leadership to influence and drive engineering and product roadmaps, focusing on scalability, innovation, and business value. You'll have a direct impact on company-wide decisions;
  • Foster engineering excellence by advancing best practices, improving development processes, and ensuring the technical vision remains relevant and actionable. You’ll champion the use of cutting-edge technologies and techniques to maintain a competitive edge;
  • Work closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure engineering outputs drive measurable business success, such as user growth, operational efficiency, and revenue generation;
  • Cultivate a high-performing culture by mentoring engineering leaders and teams, ensuring continuous professional development and creating a clear path for career progression;
  • Ensure critical systems and services operate at high availability and scalability while remaining adaptable to new business models and client needs;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Drive data-driven decision-making processes, ensuring that metrics and KPIs guide engineering priorities and resource allocation;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.
Main requirements WHO YOU ARE

  • You are a technical professional with a passion for software and product development;
  • You are accountable for your decisions and possess a high level of ownership over the products you are delivering.
  • Experienced in managing managers (leads), as well as guiding multiple teams of software engineers across different locations, helping them align with business goals;
  • Experienced in designing and developing complex modern web applications;
  • You excel in mentoring engineering leads and their teams, helping them grow their leadership and technical skills. You are proactive in driving technical growth, code quality, and operational excellence across multiple teams;
  • You have excellent communication skills, able to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams towards common objectives;
  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • You have a deep understanding of systems and can actively troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and work with teams to quickly and efficiently resolve critical problems when needed. You balance strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in key technical challenges;
  • You need to be able to articulate ideas clearly when speaking to groups in English;
  • Solid experience dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers such as RabbitMQ, KAFKA, ActiveMQ, etc and an in depth understanding of their use cases and pitfalls.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in managing managers (leads), dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers are mandatory requirements . Benefits & Perks WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!
Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. 
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. 
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training
description:
About the Role:


We are looking for detail-oriented and language-savvy professionals to support AI training through high-quality data annotation, content writing, and linguistic evaluation. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with language, structured data, and written content, and who are interested in contributing to the development of AI and NLP systems. You will play a key role in improving model accuracy, clarity, and usability by creating, reviewing, and annotating language data.


Job Title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training


Experience Level: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in any discipline (Linguistics, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or related fields preferred)


Key Responsibilities:

  • Annotate and label text, audio, or image data according to defined project guidelines.
  • Create, rewrite, and edit content such as prompts, responses, summaries, or examples for AI training.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, grammar, tone, and clarity.
  • Identify and flag issues related to ambiguity, bias, factual errors, or inconsistencies in content.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure annotated and written data meets required standards.
  • Follow detailed instructions and annotation schemas with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve annotation guidelines and content quality.


Qualifications:

  • Strong written English skills with good grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed guidelines and workflows.
  • Experience in data annotation, content writing, editing, or reviewing is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI, NLP, or language models is a plus but not mandatory.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and quality.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
